enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains motionless. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Yawns. Rubs eyes. Turns again. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Applies soap. Washes face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl and pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into bowl. Adds milk to bowl. Whisk eggs. Pours mixture into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off stove. Places eggs on plate. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Places dishes in sink. Turns on tap. Rinses dishes. Turns off tap.

Puts on shoes. Picks up bag. Opens door. Walks out. Closes door. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Gets off bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to locker room. Changes into scrubs. Walks to nurses' station. Logs into computer. Reviews patient charts. Checks vital signs of patient. Administers medication. Updates patient records. Talks to patient. Talks to doctor. Walks to supply room. Restocks supplies. Washes hands. Uses hand sanitizer. Talks to colleague. Answers phone. Schedules appointment. Walks to patient room. Assists patient. Returns to station.
Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects food. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Talks to colleague. Clears tray. Throws away trash. Walks out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Returns to nurses' station. Checks emails. Answers phone. Talks to patient. Administers medication. Updates records. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Walks to patient room. Assists with procedure. Washes hands. Talks to doctor. Updates chart. Walks to supply room. Restocks supplies. Returns to station.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Gets off bus. Walks home. Opens door. Enters house. Closes door. Locks door. Takes off shoes. Puts down bag.

Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Takes out pot. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Adds ingredients to pot. Stirs pot. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Puts plate on table. Takes out fork and knife. Sits down. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Places dishes in sink. Turns on tap. Rinses dishes. Turns off tap.

Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Scrolls through phone. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to living room. Sits on couch. Drinks. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to bathroom.
Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Washes face. Dries face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out.
Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Picks up book. Sits on bed. Opens book. Reads. Turns page. Reads. Closes book. Puts down book. Turns off desk lamp. Lies down.
Lies in bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Continues sleeping.
